data.description: 【飞鸟马时 · 沙滩整理耳机】热浪翻滚的夏日海滩阳伞下，时端坐在沙滩垫上细致地调试防水通讯耳麦，海风吹起她耀眼的金发与泳装系带。她转头看向身旁的你，比出一个坚定的胜利手势——「海浪声已被降噪过滤，现在时能百分之百听清主人的每一句心声了……Peace Peace ✌️✌️。」
data.promptProse: Toki sits upright on a beach mat beneath a parasol, adjusting her waterproof headset before turning toward the viewer with a firm peace sign. Her white-and-blue swimsuit and small tactical waist belt retain the secret-agent summer outfit. The eye-level medium view includes sand around the mat and the sea beyond. Sunlight catches her blonde hair outside the canopy, while parasol shade keeps her hands and headset softly readable.
data.title: 飞鸟马时 · 沙滩整理耳机
